stateContract.REQUIRED_NOW: A shared lower-level Human-pilot motion required before the issue-487 review gate can finish.
stateContract.COVERED_NOW: At least one exact clip exists in the immutable 400-clip candidate library. This is source coverage, not visual acceptance.
stateContract.PARTIAL: An exact candidate covers only part of the semantic, contact, equipment, transition, or recovery contract.
stateContract.MISSING: No clip in the 400-clip library satisfies the required semantic without substantial new motion production.
stateContract.DEFERRED_HIGHER_LEVEL: Distinct higher-level class or spell-signature choreography is explicitly outside the current pilot gate.

runtimeAcceptanceContract.COVERED: An authored standalone runtime asset has passed independent review and is installed with exact-byte provenance.
runtimeAcceptanceContract.COVERED_SHARED: The same accepted authored clip legitimately satisfies this semantic row without relabeling or weakening its motion contract.
runtimeAcceptanceContract.PARTIAL: An accepted authored clip satisfies only a named part of the row; the remaining part still requires accepted motion.
runtimeAcceptanceContract.MISSING: No accepted authored runtime motion currently satisfies this row.
